Stage 4: Deliver the order

The process of the stage, and where each process step is measured exists proposed cannot be counted

Expectations, entry, outcomes and alerts

Expected by each party
  • The customer who placed the order: a shipped order reaches the customer (proposed).

    Met when:

    • The order delivered to the customer.
    • The code records nothing after Shipped (proposed).
    Objective: not stated.
A case enters
  • from Stage 3: Expected outcome: The order is shipped
Expected outcomes
  • Process step 4.2: The order is delivered to the customer: No record to count: No move carries delivery in the code: the order status enum ends at Shipped, the ship command is the last status change, and the only handler of OrderStatusChangedToShippedIntegrationEvent posts to webhook subscribers and records no delivery. The carrier delivers outside the application
Other outcomes
No record to count: The code records nothing after Shipped, so neither a delivery nor a failed or returned one is recorded
Cannot be undone
Does not apply: Its one recorded move tells webhook subscribers and does not change the order; shipping itself, which cannot be undone, is in stage ST3
At stake

  • For the whole flow:

    • Order id ("Id").
    • Order total (sum of Units x UnitPrice).
    • Items and units (ordering."orderItems").
    • Buyer (ordering.buyers "IdentityGuid").
    • Delivery address.
    • Payment method (card number masked to the last four digits).
Its alerts
  • Shipped orders not confirmed delivered within the expected time
